name: url_length
description: Total character length of the normalized URL

name: hostname_length
description: Character length of the hostname

name: path_length
description: Character length of the pathname

name: query_length
description: Character length of the query string

name: num_dots
description: Number of dot (.) characters in URL

name: num_hyphens
description: Number of hyphen (-) characters in hostname

name: num_digits
description: Total digit count in URL

name: num_special_chars
description: Total special characters count in URL

name: num_slashes
description: Number of slash (/) characters in path

name: num_at_symbols
description: Count of @ symbols (credential injection)

name: num_percent_encoded
description: Count of % hex-encoded character sequences

name: num_subdomains
description: Count of subdomain levels

name: num_parameters
description: Count of query parameters

name: num_path_segments
description: Count of directory path segments

name: has_ip_address
description: 1 if hostname is a raw IPv4/IPv6 address, else 0

name: has_punycode
description: 1 if hostname contains punycode (xn--) or non-ASCII, else 0

name: has_port
description: 1 if non-standard port specified in URL, else 0

name: has_https
description: 1 if protocol is HTTPS, else 0

name: has_suspicious_tld
description: 1 if TLD is in high-abuse registrar list, else 0

name: digit_ratio
description: Ratio of digits to total URL length

name: special_char_ratio
description: Ratio of special chars to total URL length

name: hostname_entropy
description: Shannon entropy (randomness) of hostname string

name: path_entropy
description: Shannon entropy of path string

name: url_entropy
description: Shannon entropy of entire URL string

name: has_sensitive_keyword
description: 1 if path/query contains sensitive fraud keywords

name: has_brand_token_mismatch
description: 1 if brand keyword in path/subdomain but not official domain

name: is_url_shortener
description: 1 if domain is a known URL shortening service

name: has_homoglyphs
description: 1 if hostname contains lookalike Cyrillic/Greek characters
